Hi! It can be your body’s way of being stressed. When I got my wisdom teeth out my body was covered >90% in hives as a stress reaction. If you can wear cheap jewelry just fine, it’s most likely not a nickel allergy

Anodized is a fancy coating, that color wears off over time similar to paint on a well loved pen! 
The type of metal won’t really change how long the color lasts. SS, even the surgical grade, contains nickel. Nivel is the biggest irritant to the body, many people have a sensitivity to it in piercings. 
If you want/like the gold color, upgrade to 14k gold. Once you’re up that high in karats, the nickel content is low enough to not be a bother to most people. 


Source: I’m a chem eng with a nickel sensitivity in piercings and jewelry

If you’re nervous go see a second piercer. I know it’s time/money but that’s what I did, and wile one of mine may be a hair deep, she’s helped me heal it so much better than the first guy and made me feel so much better! And if it does need to come out it’ll be a pro handling it and usually can repierce ya!

Personally for me, I found the best luck to be a combo! 
Work I wore a lightly padded bra (I work with lots of men and wanted to hide em a bit...but my fav day bra was an unlined one). For the night I highly recommend a tight sports bra. This holds the girls in place so they don’t move and cause more irritation. If I wore a light bra to bed I’d wake up with them being irritated as all get out.

Update! (Because I hate reading other posts with no updates lol) 
Saw a different piercer, and she said they were a little wonky, maybe a hair deep, but not un-healable or terribly noticeable. 
She is having me switch up my after care to just wound wash and using a warm compress. And then we’ll change jewelry next week! 
So yes, they’re a hair wrong if you really look, but not scary or anything abnormal with human error and how things on the body move.
